主要内容: The document titled 'j3101406k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, published on March 11, 2014. It outlines the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series F, including $1,000,000,000 of 2.150% Senior Notes and $650,000,000 of Senior Floating Rate Notes, both due on March 15, 2019. The filing includes legal opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP regarding the validity of the notes and tax matters. The report is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s Registration Statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-189888). The filing is signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada.
